app.title: Moment
backup.export_desc: Share the zip to the Files app
backup.export_msg: Package all notes, attachments and avatars into a zip, saved or sent via the system share panel.
backup.icloud_note: Tip: when exporting, choose “Save to Files” in the share panel to store the backup in iCloud Drive; when importing, you can also pick the backup file from iCloud Drive.
backup.import_desc: Pick a zip from the Files app to restore
backup.import_msg: Importing overwrites all current data. This cannot be undone.
backup.stale_banner: Your last successful backup is over 7 days old and notes have changed since. Export a fresh backup.
bg.sub: Set a background color for this note
bg.title: Background
bridge.disconnect_note: Revoking invalidates this pairing and its client key at once; pair again to reconnect.
bridge.enable_note: When on, a paired assistant can read app state, diagnostics and notes via the relay while the app is in the foreground. Turning it off disconnects immediately.
bridge.pair_hint: On the pairing page, check the fingerprint matches exactly before confirming, and choose the capabilities to grant.
bridge.pair_expired: This pairing round has expired — start pairing again
bridge.pair_qr_hint: Scan with another device's camera to open the pairing page on that device
bridge.pair_waiting: Waiting for confirmation on the pairing page…
bridge.title: MCP Bridge
bridge.unpaired_note: Not paired yet. Start pairing, then open the pairing page on another device to confirm.
diag.autodel_note: When on, logs older than 30 days are deleted automatically
diag.title: Diagnostics
export.html_detail: Save as a standalone web page
export.pdf_note: PDF opens the browser print dialog, where you can save it as a PDF file.
export.pdf_blocked: The browser blocked the PDF export window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
export.pdf_failed: PDF export failed. Please try again.
export.title: Export Note
lang.failed: Download failed — check your connection and retry
lang.title: Language
list.empty_tip: No notes yet, tap New above
empty.search_sub: Try another keyword, or clear the search to see all notes
empty.load_error_sub: Reading local data failed. Try reloading; if it keeps failing, check the diagnostics log in Settings
gestures.title: Gestures
gestures.swipe_desc: Swipe left on a note in the list to pin or delete it. Deletes can be undone within 8 seconds
gestures.longpress_desc: In the editor, long-press a block for about half a second to pick it up and drag to reorder. Long-pressing a block you are editing selects text instead
gestures.slash_desc: Type / in an empty paragraph to insert headings, to-dos, images, cards and more
gestures.columns_desc: On wide screens, turn on two columns in the editor menu; each column mixes blocks and scrolls independently
gestures.search_desc: Tap the search capsule at the top of the list to search titles and body text
hint.editor_gestures: Long-press a block to drag and reorder · Type / in an empty paragraph to insert blocks · Swipe a list row to delete or pin
shortcuts.line: Desktop shortcuts: / Search · N New · J/K Move · Esc Back
media.add_image_hint: Long-press for the menu, then tap Edit to add an image
menu.bg_sub: Set a background color for this note
menu.twopane_sub: Tablet and PC can scroll two panes separately
settings.backup_stale_warn: Over 7 days old with newer edits — back up again
settings.title: Settings
settings.weather_len_hint_qw: QWeather keys are usually 32 characters — please check
settings.weather_len_hint_cy: Caiyun keys are usually 16 characters — please check
settings.weather_note: The built-in key is used by default; a custom key takes priority and is stored only on this device.
settings.font_system_note: Adjust in Settings › Display & Brightness › Text Size
slash.image_text_row_sub: Image and text side by side
slash.img_text_card_sub: Rounded card, image on top, text below
slash.link_invalid: Enter a valid http or https link
status.import_invalid: Import failed: the selected file is not a valid backup zip (existing data untouched)
status.imported: Imported: {n} memos · {m} attachments (saved on this device)
media.music_paste_hint: Paste a music link, hit Enter...
media.music_click_hint: Tap to paste a music link
storage.occupied_sub: This app is already open in another tab. Close that tab and this one will continue automatically.
storage.readonly_banner: Compatibility mode (read-only): the new storage is temporarily unavailable. Showing your most recently saved copy — you can view and export, but not edit for now.
storage.ephemeral_banner: Private / temporary session: the local database is unavailable in this mode. Your work is kept only in this window and will be cleared when it closes.
storage.session_banner: The local database is temporarily unavailable, so a backup storage is in use. Your changes are saved as usual and the database will be restored automatically on next launch.
storage.unavailable_sub: The new storage failed to start. Close other tabs and tap retry; if it still fails, open the rescue panel and start in compatibility mode.
attach.card_save_failed: Couldn't save the card image, so it wasn't added. Please try again.
attach.image_only: Only image files are accepted here. Please choose again.
attach.read_failed: Couldn't read the image, so it wasn't added.
attach.save_failed: Attachment save failed. Insertion canceled — please try again.
errbadge.attach_db_closed: Attachment save failed: database not open
notice.launch_streak: The app failed to finish starting {n} times in a row. Export diagnostics in Settings and make a backup.
notice.quarantine: {n} notes had corrupted data and were quarantined; everything else is intact. The quarantined originals are included in backup exports.
notice.save_serialize: Save failed: this note can't be written right now, and its content only exists on this page. Export a backup and restart the app.
notice.save_db_closed: Save failed: the database isn't open, and edits only exist on this page. Restart the app.
notice.save_write: Save failed: a database write error occurred, and edits only exist on this page. Export a backup and restart the app.
notice.launch_once: The last launch didn't finish. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics from Settings.
rescue.title: App Rescue
rescue.boundary: The app didn't finish starting last time, so it has started in Safe Mode. Your memos and attachments are stored in the on-device database and have not been changed. You can export diagnostics for the developer, or try starting normally. If this keeps happening, don't delete the app — deleting it removes your notes too.
rescue.export_zip_unavailable: The library isn't open, so backup export isn't available yet
rescue.cache_clear_confirm: This only clears caches. Your memos and attachments won't be touched.
rescue.watchdog_bar: The app doesn't seem to be responding
rescue.readonly_banner: Read-only mode: you can view and export, but not edit
rescue.readonly_write_blocked: Editing is blocked in read-only mode; this change was ignored
